verdict.rationale: Postman supports designing/exporting APIs in OpenAPI-compatible formats via Spec Hub and the Postman Collection format, and its own documentation site exposes machine-readable OpenAPI (postman-probe-3) confirming the company is OpenAPI-aware, but the evidence pack doesn't show a direct, documented 'export collection/API as OpenAPI spec' feature description aimed at AI-native consumption, nor confirmation that exported specs are agent-consumable out of the box. missing for 10: explicit docs on exporting a Postman API/Collection as an OpenAPI file, confirmation of spec fidelity/tooling for AI agents, independent hands-on verification of the export workflow.
